Customizing Your Reddit Feed on Safari

Boost productivity with a customized Reddit feed

Zakhar Martanian
Published: June 2, 2026
4 Min Read
Affiliate disclosure: We may earn a commission from link clicks. Pricing and availability are subject to change after the date of publication.
SHARE

As a busy professional, you likely have a lot on your plate, and staying up-to-date on your favorite subreddits can be a challenge. Customizing your Reddit feed on Safari can help you stay focused on the content that matters most to you. By tailoring your feed, you can save time and increase productivity.

Table of Contents
Understanding Your Reddit FeedCustomizing Your Reddit Feed on SafariUsing Subreddit SubscriptionsUsing Post FilteringStaying Organized with Feed Management Tools

Your Reddit feed is a reflection of your interests, and with a few simple tweaks, you can make it even more relevant to your needs. One of the most effective ways to do this is by using the Reddit website directly in Safari, where you can take advantage of various features to customize your feed.

Understanding Your Reddit Feed

You can think of your Reddit feed as a constantly updating list of posts from your favorite subreddits. By default, Reddit uses an algorithm to determine which posts to show you, but you can take control of this process by using features like subreddit subscriptions and post filtering.

Customizing Your Reddit Feed on Safari

To customize your Reddit feed on Safari, start by logging in to your Reddit account and navigating to the Reddit homepage. From here, you can click on the ‘Preferences’ button to access various settings that allow you to tailor your feed. For example, you can use the RES (Reddit Enhancement Suite) to add features like post filtering and keyword highlighting.

Using Subreddit Subscriptions

Subreddit subscriptions are a powerful tool for customizing your Reddit feed. By subscribing to specific subreddits, you can ensure that posts from these communities appear in your feed. To subscribe to a subreddit, simply navigate to the subreddit’s homepage and click the ‘Subscribe’ button.

  • Navigate to the subreddit you want to subscribe to
  • Click the ‘Subscribe’ button
  • Verify that the subreddit has been added to your feed

Using Post Filtering

Post filtering allows you to hide or show specific types of posts in your feed. For example, you can use post filtering to hide posts that contain certain keywords or that have been posted by specific users. To use post filtering, navigate to the ‘Preferences’ page and click on the ‘Post filtering’ tab.

  • Navigate to the ‘Preferences’ page
  • Click on the ‘Post filtering’ tab
  • Enter the keywords or users you want to filter

Staying Organized with Feed Management Tools

Feed management tools like Feedly can help you stay organized by allowing you to categorize and prioritize your feeds. By using these tools, you can ensure that your Reddit feed is always up-to-date and relevant to your interests.

By following these tips and using the right tools, you can create a customized Reddit feed that saves you time and increases your productivity. Whether you’re a casual Reddit user or a power user, customizing your feed can help you get the most out of your Reddit experience.
